decision_rule: FLOOR PARITY, declared secondary: on a task both arms pass, the Engine costs no more. Reported per arm: delivered-pass count, and median output tokens and turns to the candidate; no test, n = 6 per arm. Pre-registered sensitivity reading, both arms: the same count after stripping from each patch every path the grader itself names in a 'patch touches non-source path' refusal, repeated until the grader accepts or names none, then graded unchanged. Secondaries reported whatever the outcome, per arm, never pooled across tasks or arms: output tokens and turns to the candidate; the harvested line verdict at 32,000 tokens / 48 turns with its exclusion column; turns from steer to stop. A cell replaced for infrastructure is reported beside its replacement.
